newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline weakens with screen, arb closed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline weakens with screen, arb closed.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices suffered again at the hands of a falling NYMEX futures screen on Wednesday, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded in small volumes at $190 and 1$91 a tonne fob ARA, while an Antwerp refiner was heard to have sold a small piece at a 50 cent discount to the mean of published quotes.
July swaps were talked in a range between $181 and $183 for much of the afternoon but a late fall in futures put this under further pressure, dealers said.
Arbitrage opportunities to the United States were still considered closed and traders said relative prices had to shift by at least another five dollars before new volumes sail westwards from Europe.
